# 1500DollarSite.com

> A custom, professionally built 5–10 page website for your small business for a flat $1,500. Copywriting, design, and local SEO included. You own the code, hosting is free, and there are no required monthly fees. A service of IODEV.

1500DollarSite.com is a service of IODEV (https://www.iodev.com), founded by Cory Keane. It builds custom static websites for U.S. small businesses.

## Key facts

- Price: $1,500 flat for a custom 5–10 page website ($750 upfront, $750 at launch)
- Larger or custom projects: custom pricing, quoted by IODEV (https://www.iodev.com)
- Included: custom design, copywriting, photos (yours or royalty-free stock photos), basic text logo, contact forms, mobile-first build, local SEO setup, Google Business Profile help, one full round of revisions, 30 days of launch support
- Ownership: the client owns the code, content, domain, and hosting account
- Ongoing costs: no required monthly fees; hosting is free (usually Cloudflare Pages); the client pays only for their domain (~$10–$20/year)
- Optional services: one-off updates $75/hour, Website Care $49/month, Local SEO Growth from $199/month
- Typical timeline: about one month
- Service areas: in person in Chicagoland and Dallas–Fort Worth; remote nationwide
- Contact: https://1500dollarsite.com/contact/
